description: Waits for a new email to arrive in the agent's inbox and returns it in full. Use it right after signing up somewhere to catch a verification code or link. Each call waits up to 50 seconds; if nothing came, call it again with the same filters and it carries on from where the first call started, so nothing that arrived in between is missed. Only mail that arrives after the first call starts counts, unless after_message_id is given.

after_message_id.description: Count mail after this message instead of from now.

from_contains.description: Only mail whose sender contains this, like "github.com".

subject_contains.description: Only mail whose subject contains this.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait. A single call stops after 50 seconds at most.

name: wait_for_message
title: Wait for an email
